home.title: Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums
home.description: For 60 years Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums have worked to preserve the traditional music of Scotland. We are primarily a community-oriented band committed to furthering the development of piping and drumming in Kansas City.

about.title: About Us - Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums
about.description: The band's past performances and partnerships, from parades and concerts to university commencements, plus our awards, honors and tartan.

hire.title: Hire Us - Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums
hire.description: From weddings to sold-out concerts, the Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes and Drums will make your event unforgettable! As Kansas City's premier pipe band, we are proud to provide award-winning individual bagpipers, small ensembles, or even a full band for your next event.

join.title: Join the Band - Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums
join.description: Learn the bagpipes or drums for free in Kansas City. The Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums offers free weekly lessons, charges no dues and welcomes new members of any age.

music.title: Music - Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums
music.description: List of the tunes the band plays for competitions, parades, and events.

photo.description: Photo galleries of the band's past performances.

schedule.title: Schedule - Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums
schedule.description: A schedule of the band's upcoming performances for the year.

contact.title: Contact Us - Kansas City St. Andrew Pipes & Drums
contact.description: Contact the band about piping or drumming lessons, or booking the band for your event.
